properties.name: Soul Perception
properties.description: Perceives the souls of living beings nearby, reading their presence and state of mind, including through disguise.

properties.name: Soul Resonance
properties.description: Matches her soul's wavelength to a partner's so that their combined attack is amplified; it works only with a willing partner whose wavelength fits.

properties.name: Partner Dependence
properties.description: Resonance cannot be performed alone; without a compatible partner she cannot resonate.

properties.name: Weapon Partnership
properties.description: Fights alongside a partner who transforms into a scythe; the bond is a working relationship between two people.

properties.name: Anti-Demon Calling
properties.description: Trained to hunt corrupted souls; her role is to cut down demon-aligned souls.

properties.name: Disciplined Study
properties.description: Methodical, studious and persistent; she prepares and learns before she acts.

visual_traits.descriptor: slight, compact frame with quick, springy posture
bright, steady green eyes and a stern, focused expression
ash-blonde hair gathered in two pigtails
a black trench-style coat over a white blouse, a plaid skirt and dark boots
black, white and muted red plaid
a tall scythe with a curved blade carried at her side
faint ripples of pale light tracing the outlines of nearby living beings

exclusion_candidates.item: the literal weapon partner as a carried companion
exclusion_candidates.reason: A separate person, not a trait; only the partner's channel-shaping role can be carried.

exclusion_candidates.item: the academy setting and its hierarchy
exclusion_candidates.reason: Setting and institution, not a transferable mechanic.
